$comment: Pins the QEMU build that ships with the application. The Windows build workflow downloads this exact file, verifies the checksum, and refuses to continue on a mismatch. Bumping this version means re-verifying the checksum by hand and updating docs/licensing/qemu-source-offer.md, because the GPL obligation attaches to the specific build distributed.

source.description: Stefan Weil's Windows build of QEMU, the customary distribution for Windows hosts.

upstreamSource.description: Exact upstream commit identified by the vendor binary's version string; published alongside every release as corresponding source.

extract.$comment: Only these files are shipped. QEMU's installer contains dozens of system targets and firmware blobs; taking the x86_64 target, the two microvm direct-boot ROMs, and the q35 fallback BIOS keeps the installer inside its 250-500 MB budget.
extract.dllPolicy: Copy every DLL beside qemu-system-x86_64.exe, then smoke-test both shipped executables. This follows the exact vendor dependency set instead of a hand-maintained subset.
extract.$excluded: General-purpose PC firmware, graphical assets, and non-x86 system emulators are not shipped. See docs/architecture/overview.md.
